facts.fact: The National Civil Registration Authority released its Provisional Annual Report on Vital Events for the year ending 31 December 2023, under Section 26(1) of the National Civil Registration Act 2016, counting 235,373 live births, 13,186 deaths, 834 marriages, 41 divorces and 360 adoptions registered.
facts.system: Provisional Annual Report on Vital Events 2023

facts.fact: The 2023 provisional vital events report draws on events registered by the National Civil Registration Authority (births, stillbirths, deaths, marriages, divorces, adoptions).
